verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS fraud-prevention platform with SDKs and a dashboard, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has nothing on telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out controls, only data collection for fraud decisions, such as the recommendation to send location data on every update.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
